name: Planet Landing Defense Regression
description: Owner and corporation exemptions, denied landing, and existing Quasar and planetary-fighter defense resolution.

tests.name: Create owner
Create corporation member
Create outsider
Create FedSpace outsider
Fixture corporation

data.sql: INSERT INTO corporations (corporation_id, name, owner_id, tag) VALUES (97770, 'Landing QA Corp', @{landing_planet_owner_player_id}, 'LQA') ON CONFLICT (corporation_id) DO UPDATE SET owner_id=EXCLUDED.owner_id;

tests.name: Add member to corporation

data.sql: INSERT INTO corp_members (corporation_id, player_id, role) VALUES (97770, @{landing_planet_member_player_id}, 'Member') ON CONFLICT (corporation_id, player_id) DO UPDATE SET role='Member';

tests.name: Create owned and defended planets

data.sql: INSERT INTO planets (planet_id, sector_id, name, owner_id, owner_type, class, type, created_by, fighters) VALUES (977710,20,'Landing Owner QA',@{landing_planet_owner_player_id},'player','M',1,@{admin_player_id},0),(977711,20,'Landing Corp QA',97770,'corporation','M',1,@{admin_player_id},0),(977712,20,'Landing Quasar QA',@{landing_planet_owner_player_id},'player','M',1,@{admin_player_id},10),(977713,20,'Landing Destroyer QA',@{landing_planet_owner_player_id},'player','M',1,@{admin_player_id},10),(977714,20,'Landing Fighter QA',@{landing_planet_owner_player_id},'player','M',1,@{admin_player_id},20),(977715,20,'Landing Shield QA',@{landing_planet_owner_player_id},'player','M',1,@{admin_player_id},0),(977717,20,'Landing Undefended QA',@{landing_planet_owner_player_id},'player','M',1,@{admin_player_id},0) ON CONFLICT (planet_id) DO UPDATE SET sector_id=EXCLUDED.sector_id, owner_id=EXCLUDED.owner_id, owner_type=EXCLUDED.owner_type, fighters=EXCLUDED.fighters;

tests.name: Configure atmosphere Quasar defenses

data.sql: INSERT INTO citadels (planet_id, level, qCannonAtmosphere, militaryReactionLevel, planetaryShields, owner_id) VALUES (977710,3,100,0,0,@{landing_planet_owner_player_id}),(977711,3,100,0,0,@{landing_planet_owner_player_id}),(977712,3,100,0,0,@{landing_planet_owner_player_id}),(977713,3,200,0,0,@{landing_planet_owner_player_id}),(977714,1,0,0,0,@{landing_planet_owner_player_id}),(977715,5,0,0,20,@{landing_planet_owner_player_id}) ON CONFLICT (planet_id) DO UPDATE SET level=EXCLUDED.level, qCannonAtmosphere=EXCLUDED.qCannonAtmosphere, militaryReactionLevel=0, planetaryShields=EXCLUDED.planetaryShields;

tests.name: Position owner

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id=20 WHERE player_id=@{landing_planet_owner_player_id};

tests.name: Owner ship in sector

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=20, onplanet=FALSE, hull=100, shields=0, fighters=0 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{landing_planet_owner_player_id});

tests.name: Evidence snapshot before owner landing

data.sql: SELECT p.player_id, p.sector_id, p.lastplanet, t.turns_remaining, s.ship_id, s.onplanet, s.hull, s.shields, (SELECT count(*) FROM engine_events e WHERE e.actor_player_id=p.player_id) AS event_count FROM players p JOIN turns t USING (player_id) JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=p.ship_id WHERE p.player_id=@{landing_planet_owner_player_id};

tests.name: Zero-turn owner landing is refused without mutation

data.sql: UPDATE turns SET turns_remaining=0 WHERE player_id=@{landing_planet_owner_player_id};

tests.name: Reject owner landing with zero turns
Verify zero-turn landing preserved state

data.sql: SELECT p.sector_id=20 AND p.lastplanet IS NULL AND t.turns_remaining=0 AND s.onplanet=FALSE AND (SELECT count(*) FROM engine_events e WHERE e.actor_player_id=p.player_id) = 0 FROM players p JOIN turns t USING (player_id) JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=p.ship_id WHERE p.player_id=@{landing_planet_owner_player_id};

tests.name: Restore owner turns after zero-turn refusal

data.sql: UPDATE turns SET turns_remaining=@{landing_owner_turns_before} WHERE player_id=@{landing_planet_owner_player_id};

tests.name: Reject malformed owner landing without mutation
Planet owner bypasses its armed Quasar defense
Verify owner landing caused no defense damage

data.sql: SELECT s.hull=100 AND s.shields=0 AND s.onplanet=TRUE AND pl.lastplanet=977710 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM engine_events WHERE type='combat.hit.quasar' AND actor_player_id=@{landing_planet_owner_player_id}) FROM ships s JOIN players pl ON pl.ship_id=s.ship_id WHERE pl.player_id=@{landing_planet_owner_player_id};

tests.name: Evidence snapshot after owner landing

data.sql: SELECT p.player_id, p.sector_id, p.lastplanet, t.turns_remaining, s.ship_id, s.onplanet, s.hull, s.shields, (SELECT count(*) FROM engine_events e WHERE e.actor_player_id=p.player_id) AS event_count FROM players p JOIN turns t USING (player_id) JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=p.ship_id WHERE p.player_id=@{landing_planet_owner_player_id};

tests.name: Position corporation member

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id=20 WHERE player_id=@{landing_planet_member_player_id};

tests.name: Corporation member ship in sector

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=20, onplanet=FALSE, hull=100, shields=0, fighters=0 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{landing_planet_member_player_id});

tests.name: Authorized corporation member bypasses armed defense
Verify corporation landing caused no defense damage

data.sql: SELECT s.hull=100 AND s.shields=0 AND s.onplanet=TRUE AND pl.lastplanet=977711 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM engine_events WHERE type='combat.hit.quasar' AND actor_player_id=@{landing_planet_member_player_id}) FROM ships s JOIN players pl ON pl.ship_id=s.ship_id WHERE pl.player_id=@{landing_planet_member_player_id};

tests.name: Position outsider

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id=20 WHERE player_id=@{landing_planet_outsider_player_id};

tests.name: Outsider ship enters sector

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=20, onplanet=FALSE, hull=100, shields=0, fighters=0 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{landing_planet_outsider_player_id});

tests.name: Undefended outsider landing is refused without damage
Verify undefended ship unchanged and not landed

data.sql: SELECT hull=100 AND onplanet=FALSE FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{landing_planet_outsider_player_id});

tests.name: Defended outsider landing is refused after Quasar damage
Verify Quasar damage and event persistence

data.sql: SELECT s.hull=100 AND s.onplanet=FALSE AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM engine_events WHERE type='combat.hit.quasar' AND actor_player_id=@{landing_planet_outsider_player_id}) FROM ships s WHERE s.ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{landing_planet_outsider_player_id});

tests.name: Set shielded attacker for Quasar damage

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET shields=40, hull=100, fighters=0 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{landing_planet_outsider_player_id});

tests.name: Quasar damage consumes shields before hull
Verify Quasar shield and hull state

data.sql: SELECT shields=0 AND hull=140 AND onplanet=FALSE FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{landing_planet_outsider_player_id});

tests.name: Enable the existing citadel military reaction level

data.sql: UPDATE citadels SET militaryReactionLevel=1 WHERE planet_id=977712;

tests.name: Prepare shielded attacker for reacted Quasar shot

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET shields=40, hull=100 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{landing_planet_outsider_player_id});

tests.name: Atmosphere Quasar uses the existing reaction multiplier
Verify reacted Quasar damage persistence

data.sql: SELECT shields=0 AND hull=115 AND onplanet=FALSE FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{landing_planet_outsider_player_id});

tests.name: Set attacker and planetary fighter pools

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET fighters=10, hull=100, shields=0 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{landing_planet_outsider_player_id});

tests.name: Citadel shield grid engages without stored planetary fighters
Verify shield-only defense consumed fighter strength

data.sql: SELECT s.fighters=0 AND c.planetaryShields=10 AND s.onplanet=FALSE FROM ships s JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id=@{landing_planet_outsider_player_id} JOIN citadels c ON c.planet_id=977715 WHERE s.ship_id=pl.ship_id;

tests.name: Reset fighters for planetary fighter exchange

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET fighters=10 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{landing_planet_outsider_player_id});

tests.name: Planetary fighters engage outsider; access remains denied
Verify fighter losses and event persistence

data.sql: SELECT s.fighters=0 AND p.fighters=10 AND s.onplanet=FALSE AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM engine_events WHERE type='combat.planet_landing_defense.v1' AND actor_player_id=@{landing_planet_outsider_player_id}) FROM ships s JOIN planets p ON p.planet_id=977714 WHERE s.ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{landing_planet_outsider_player_id});

tests.name: Reset outsider hull for lethal defense

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET hull=100, shields=0 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{landing_planet_outsider_player_id});

tests.name: Lethal Quasar defense destroys attacking ship
Verify destroyed ship and no active ship assignment

data.sql: SELECT s.destroyed=TRUE AND s.hull=0 AND p.ship_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM podded_status ps WHERE ps.player_id=p.player_id AND ps.status='active') FROM ship_ownership so JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=so.ship_id JOIN players p ON p.player_id=so.player_id WHERE so.player_id=@{landing_planet_outsider_player_id} ORDER BY so.ship_id DESC LIMIT 1;

tests.name: Create armed FedSpace planet

data.sql: INSERT INTO planets (planet_id, sector_id, name, owner_id, owner_type, class, type, created_by, fighters) VALUES (977716,1,'Landing FedSpace QA',@{landing_planet_owner_player_id},'player','M',1,@{admin_player_id},50) ON CONFLICT (planet_id) DO UPDATE SET sector_id=1, owner_id=EXCLUDED.owner_id, owner_type=EXCLUDED.owner_type, fighters=50;

tests.name: Configure armed FedSpace planet

data.sql: INSERT INTO citadels (planet_id, level, qCannonAtmosphere, militaryReactionLevel, planetaryShields, owner_id) VALUES (977716,3,200,0,0,@{landing_planet_owner_player_id}) ON CONFLICT (planet_id) DO UPDATE SET level=3, qCannonAtmosphere=200, militaryReactionLevel=0, planetaryShields=0;

tests.name: Position FedSpace outsider

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id=1 WHERE player_id=@{landing_planet_safe_outsider_player_id};

tests.name: Position FedSpace outsider ship

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=1, onplanet=FALSE, hull=100, shields=0, fighters=10 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{landing_planet_safe_outsider_player_id});

tests.name: FedSpace refusal prevents planetary defense engagement
Verify protected-sector attempt caused no damage or defense event

data.sql: SELECT s.hull=100 AND s.shields=0 AND s.fighters=10 AND s.onplanet=FALSE AND p.fighters=50 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM engine_events WHERE type IN ('combat.hit.quasar','combat.planet_landing_defense.v1') AND actor_player_id=@{landing_planet_safe_outsider_player_id}) FROM ships s JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id=@{landing_planet_safe_outsider_player_id} JOIN planets p ON p.planet_id=977716 WHERE s.ship_id=pl.ship_id;
